title: English Podcast For Learning English | Real English Conversation Practice | Talk About Your Day

sentences.t: Hello and welcome back to Leo English podcast.
I'm Tina.
And I'm Leo.

Our podcast uses real conversations, not boring textbook examples.
You can listen while you walk, cook, or relax at home.
Yes, and today's topic is very useful.
We are talking about your day.
That's right. We will talk about our daily routines from morning till night.
This topic is special because everyone has a day.
You wake up, you work, you eat, you sleep.
So you can use this English every single day.
Imagine your co-worker asks, "So, how was your day?"
Today, you will learn exactly how to answer that question.
If you are new here, please like this video and subscribe to our channel.
It really helps us a lot.
Okay, Tina. I think they're ready.
Let's get started.

Only three?

The afternoon slump.

Morning, small tasks.

You calm your body and your mind.

I know, I know.

Morning, afternoon, evening, night.

Monday mornings. My desk, my emails, my brain, everything is loud.
Next word, the afternoon slump.

Saturday morning, then Sunday is my official TV day.
